title: the origin annihilates and never joins the circuit — a machine-checked theorem of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit
description:
the origin annihilates and never joins the circuit, declared in src/proof/index.lean and accepted by the Lean 4 kernel, sorry-free and axiom-free, closing by by decide.

Statement (Lean):

((List.range 9).all (fun e => (0 * e) % 9 != 1)) ∧ (! span.contains 0) ∧ ((List.range 9).all (fun d => (d + 0) % 9 == d % 9))

Statement (LaTeX):

\forall e \in \{0,\dots,8\},\; 0 \cdot e \bmod 9 \neq 1 \land \lnot 0 \in \mathrm{span} \land \forall d \in \{0,\dots,8\},\; d + 0 \bmod 9 = d \bmod 9

It is not a claim that the result is unknown to the literature: prior art for this file is recorded in src/proof/priorart.lean as unclassified — no prior-art search has been performed, so no novelty is asserted.

Scope. The declaration is decided over a finite domain by exhaustion. It settles no Clay Millennium Problem and claims no quantum speedup. 0/7.
